problems.evidence: Learning the vi and Vim Editors, 8th Edition

summary: Summary: this slice contains no instructional prose. It is the tail of the book's alphabetical back-of-book index (headwords from 'bottom-line command overview' through 'ZZ to quit and save', covering letters S-Z), followed by two back-matter sections, 'About the Authors' (biographies of Arnold Robbins and Elbert Hannah) and the 'Colophon' describing the tarsier cover animal.
